title: Battle of Carchemish (605 BC)
summary: Nebuchadnezzar, as Babylonian crown prince, defeated the Egyptian army of Necho II at Carchemish on the Euphrates. Jeremiah 46:2 dates the battle to the fourth year of Jehoiakim.
external_reason: External historical event documented by the Babylonian Chronicle (ABC 5); referenced in Jeremiah 46:2.

mentions.notes: Superscription of the oracle against Egypt.

scripture_extraction.reason: External event; Jeremiah not yet extracted (Rule 01 will add Jer 46 candidates in M6).
